verdict.rationale: AWS supports versioning/rollback of infrastructure automations via CloudFormation stacks (create/update/delete, rollback on failure) and CDK's code-based infrastructure definitions stored in version control, plus CLI history tracking. However, there's no dedicated review/approval workflow or diff-based review UI evidenced, and no AI-native automation-specific versioning (e.g., for agent workflows) beyond generic infra-as-code tooling. missing for 10: evidence of built-in review/approval workflows for changes, rollback support specifically for AI agent automations/AgentCore workflows, and a unified changelog/diff view across automation types.
